label: early original-phase steps (t=2-4) after o/p/q/z appeared in the prefix
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase, almost entirely at t=2-4 (t=2 alone holds 54% of mass, t=3 36%); never at t=0, the delimiter, or in the copy phase. Within those steps it is graded by which tokens opened the sequence: o, p, q, z (and less so k, a, w) as first/prev/prev2 tokens give 3-7x lift, and the strongest activations come from sequences starting o o or p p followed by z/0/q. Current token z, 0, c, o, e, f boost it, and it fires mostly on first occurrences of the token. The predicate captures ~93% of activation mass, but precision is only ~0.12: most early steps after o/p/q/z stay below threshold, so magnitude reflects a graded mix of the early tokens. Requiring two of these tokens raises precision to ~0.3 but loses half the mass.
